candidates.text: This Grade 5 Common Core Comprehension Aid provides mini-lessons and reading passages at three levels for narrative, informational, and opinion/persuasive texts. It includes text-dependent comprehension and vocabulary questions along with an answer key.

Help Grade 5 students build comprehension skills aligned with Common Core State Standards using scaffolded passages at three reading levels, progressing from their current level up to the on-grade-level expectation. Each title includes instant mini-lessons for narrative, informational, and opinion/persuasive text, text-dependent comprehension and vocabulary questions, and a complete answer key.

Handmade from genuine leather in a vibrant coral finish, this 9x7 traveler's notebook comes with 4 refillable inserts held by elastic bands for easy swapping. Perfect for planning, journaling, or note-taking on the go, and it fits the Leafy Treetop booklet.

This handmade genuine leather refillable notebook measures 9x7 and includes four refillable inserts bound by elastic bands. It is designed for planning and journaling, with additional space to hold personal items like passports and receipts.

The Ensign Brown journal from EGI features a brown bonded leather cover and comes with a black feather pen for a classic writing set. This compact 13.6-ounce pair measures about 8.25 by 6 inches, making it easy to tuck into a bag or keep on your desk.

This EGI Bonded Leather Journal features a classic brown cover and includes one black feather pen, making it perfect for writers who need durable writing tools in a compact size of 8.25 x 6 x 0.6 inches.

This 600-piece set of metallic color push pins features 1/8-inch round heads and stainless steel points for use on maps, cork boards, and bulletin boards. The pins come in six colors and are stored in a clear, reconfigurable plastic container.

This 600-count set of multi-color map tacks comes in 6 retro metallic colors—black, silver, gold, rose gold, KC gold, and bronze—with 100 pins per color, each 1/8 inch round head with a stainless steel point. The reconfigurable clear case keeps colors sorted and ready for bulletin boards, cork boards, map marking, fabric marking, and DIY projects.

Personalize your mail with this set of 150 mermaid-themed return address labels, each measuring 2.75 x 1 inches with a matte, self-adhesive peel-and-stick finish. You'll receive 5 sheets of 30 labels with your choice of font and font color.

Add a playful mermaid touch to your mail with this set of 150 personalized matte address labels. Each self-adhesive, peel-and-stick label measures 2.75" x 1", and you'll receive 5 sheets of 30 labels, with font and font color choices available.

Keep your schedule visible with this Qivange magnetic dry erase calendar, designed to stick to your refrigerator for easy planning at a glance. The 16 x 12 inch whiteboard comes with 4 dry erase markers so you can start organizing right away.

The Qivange Magnetic Dry Erase Calendar is a white, 16 x 12-inch refrigerator planner featuring magnetic dry erase markers for easy writing and erasing. This lightweight item weighs just 14.4 ounces and includes four matching dry erase markers to keep your fridge organized all year long.

This is a 2008 limited edition album by Juno Award-winning Canadian Country Music star What I Do, featuring the first single "Just Like You" and credits from Chad Kroeger and Richard Marx. The disc contains one copy of the Universal Import release with dimensions of 5.44 x 0.19 x 4.99 inches and a weight of 1.6 ounces.

What I Do is the 2008 album from the Juno Award-winning Canadian country music star, featuring writing and production credits from Chad Kroeger and Richard Marx along with the first single "Just Like You." This single-disc release is brought to you on Universal Import.

TRUBIND Chicago screw and post sets include 100 heavy-duty aluminum screws with 100 matching posts, each with a 3/16 inch post length and diameter, ideal for binding documents, albums, and swatch books. The reusable two-piece design makes it easy to update or replace pages, with a recommended hole size of 1/4 to 5/16 inch.

This set of 100 heavy-duty aluminum Chicago screws and posts features a 3/16-inch diameter designed for binding loose documents, swatches, and architectural drawings. The durable hardware allows you to easily update or expand your project without needing to replace the entire binder.

This six-pack of Pilot G2 Pro retractable gel-ink pens features black ink and a 0.7mm fine point. The professional design includes metal accents and a comfortable black rubber grip in a variety of barrel colors.

Stock up with this 6-pack of Pilot G2 Pro retractable gel ink pens, each with smooth-writing black ink, a fine 0.7mm point, and a comfortable rubber grip with metal accents. These refillable pens come in five barrel colors—turquoise, gray, blue, silver, and purple—for a refined, professional look.

Print your own labels and stickers with this 60-sheet pack of matte white sticker paper in letter size (8.5" x 11"), compatible with both laser and inkjet printers. Each self-adhesive sheet peels and sticks to cardboard, plastic, paper, and other flat surfaces, while the matte finish helps reduce ink smudges.

This pack of 60 sheets features a matte white finish that reduces ink smudges and mimics the feel of writing paper, making it perfect for laser or inkjet printers. Each sheet measures 8.5" x 11", providing ample space for notes, labels, or small prints on flat surfaces like cardboard and plastic.

This Chucky horror movie themed extended mouse pad measures 29.5" x 15.8" to accommodate both your keyboard and mouse. It is made from waterproof polyester and rubber with an anti-slip base to keep the mat securely in place.

This large gaming mouse pad features a durable rubber and polyester cloth surface with an extended 29.5" x 15.8" size to comfortably accommodate both your mouse and keyboard while protecting your desk from spills and scratches. It includes a non-skid anti-slip rubber base for stability and offers a smooth, waterproof coating ideal for fast gaming or writing on any computer desktop.

The Kodak Alaris S2040 document scanner captures up to 40 pages per minute with embedded image processing for crisp, high-quality scans, and its 80-page automatic document feeder uses Active Feed Technology to keep pages aligned and prevent misfeeds. It connects via USB 3.1, includes a 3-year advanced unit replacement, and comes bundled with Alaris Smart Touch and Capture Pro Software Limited Edition for Windows.

The Kodak Alaris S2040 is a compact document scanner featuring an 80-page automatic feeder that delivers crisp, high-quality images at up to 40 pages per minute. It includes bundled Windows software and comes with a three-year unit replacement warranty for reliable performance.

This Aelfox ergonomic wrist rest features a soft memory foam design that fits standard laptops and gaming keyboards, providing neutral wrist support to reduce fatigue during typing. The pad includes a non-slip rubberized base for stability and is hand-washable for easy maintenance.

This ergonomic keyboard wrist rest measures 14.17" x 2.32" x 0.7" and is designed for slim Tenkeyless keyboards and laptops, helping keep your wrists in a neutral position while typing. Made from soft, conforming memory foam with a smooth, low-friction surface and a non-slip rubberized base, it provides comfortable support and stays securely in place during use.

This officially licensed NCAA team holder features an enameled brass medallion with the team logo and includes one 3" x 3" memo pad, making it perfect for jotting down quick notes while showing off your school spirit.
Show your school spirit with this officially licensed NCAA memo pad holder featuring an enameled brass team logo medallion. Each holder includes one 3" x 3" memo pad.

The GAINSCHA Mini Label Maker is a compact, portable Bluetooth printer that lets you create labels for organizing your office, home, or kitchen from your iPhone or Android device. It features a built-in lithium ion battery with convenient USB recharging and a lightweight design you can take anywhere.

Keep home, office, and kitchen spaces organized with this compact GAINSCHA Bluetooth label maker, which pairs with iOS and Android devices for simple sticker and tag printing. It runs on a built-in USB-rechargeable battery, and its small, lightweight design with automatic sleep mode makes it easy to use anywhere.

Protect documents, blueprints, and posters during shipping, mailing, or storage with these 2-inch x 20-inch black mailing tubes, available in a pack of 50. Each tube features strong 3-ply spiral wound construction and seals securely with a white plastic end cap.

Keep documents, blueprints, and posters protected in transit with these black mailing tubes, each measuring 2 x 20 inches with a glossy finish and white plastic end caps. This pack of 50 features strong 3-ply spiral wound construction, making the tubes ideal for shipping, storing, and mailing important materials.

This 20-piece set of ballpoint pens features printed Bible verses and motivational messages in black ink with 1.0 mm tips. Each metallic-looking pen includes a touch stylus compatible with most modern touchscreen devices.

This set of 20 black-ink ballpoint pens features engraved Bible verses and inspirational messages on a sleek metallic body. Each 14.5 cm pen writes smoothly with a 1.0 mm point, and the built-in stylus tip works with most touchscreen devices.

Upgrade or customize your notebook with this gold set of eleven 1 1/2" Levenger Circa discs, crafted from lightweight, polished aluminum for quick, easy page turning. Each 1 1/2" disc holds up to 200 sheets, and the set makes one letter-size notebook or a junior notebook plus a Jotlet.
These gold 1 1/2" Circa Discs are made of lightweight aluminum for easy page turning. This set of 11 can hold up to 200 sheets and is enough to make one letter-size notebook.

Keep your A4 documents organized and protected with this 10-piece set of white PVC mesh file bags. Each bag features a secure zipper closure and a waterproof, durable mesh design for safe, convenient paper storage.
Organize your documents with this 10-pack of white A4 size PVC mesh file bags. Each waterproof pouch features a secure zipper closure.

This is a brand-new, 100% genuine replacement toner cartridge for HP LaserJet printers (models M176, M177, and MFP series) that delivers the same page yield as original equipment manufacturer cartridges. It features high-quality magenta ink with all internal components, including OPC drums and smart chips, to ensure reliable printing every time.
This magenta toner cartridge is a compatible replacement for HP 130A CF353A, offering a page yield of 1,000 pages. It is designed for use with HP Color LaserJet Pro M176 and M177 series printers.

This 55-inch Rhilon computer desk features a scratch-resistant, waterproof double veneer desktop and 40mm thick steel legs. Measuring 55.1" x 23.62" x 29.1", it provides a spacious workstation for office or study use.

The Rhilon 55-inch computer desk offers a spacious 55.1" x 23.62" work surface with a scratch-resistant double veneer top and sturdy 40 mm steel legs with adjustable antiskid pads. Finished in wood color with black legs, this modern workstation is a versatile choice for work, study, or writing.

This wall-mounted, changeable letter board features a solid oak frame and pre-printed text for up to 290 characters. It is available in black with a canvas bag included and measures 18 inches by 12 inches.

Display custom messages with this Executive Office Solutions changeable letter board, featuring a black felt surface in a solid oak frame. The 12 x 16 inch wall-mount board comes with 290 hot pink characters and a canvas storage bag.

This set of 24 white Cash Envelope System envelopes from Proper Wolf features a gummed closure and precise dimensions of 6 1/2 x 3 5/8 inches, making them ideal for tracking monthly spending categories and amounts. The included ledger on the back allows you to record purchase details and maintain a running balance while keeping your cash organized in a neat, rectangular format.

Stay on top of your budget with this 24-pack of white cash envelopes from Proper Wolf, each printed front and back with spaces for category, amount, and month, plus a ledger to track purchases and a running balance. Sized at 6 1/2 x 3 5/8 inches, they hold standard US currency.

These Promarx red ink ballpoint pens feature a 1.0mm medium point and a tungsten carbide ball for smooth writing. This 10-count pack includes removable caps to protect the writing tips and prevent unwanted marks.

Get smooth, clean lines every time with this 10-count pack of Promarx TC Ball stick pens, featuring medium 1.0mm red ballpoint tips made with a tungsten carbide ball. The low-viscosity red ink writes reliably on all paper types, making them a handy choice for home, school, or office.

The LEAMEERY 6-in-1 multitool pen combines a blue ballpoint pen, touch screen stylus, level, ruler, and both flat head and Phillips screwdrivers in one handy design. Compatible with smartphones and made from durable ABS material, it makes a unique and practical gift for men.

This LEAMEERY Multitool Pen is a compact, twist-closure set containing 56 pieces of writing and office supplies, including a ballpoint pen, touch screen stylus, level, ruler, flat head, and Phillips screwdriver. It requires no batteries or additional ink and features an ABS material construction with a total package weight of 8.1 ounces.

Keep your desk clutter-free with this 1InTheHome six-tier desk organizer in black mesh steel, featuring a pencil cup, two vertical slots for papers, and a small drawer for supplies. Backed by a 1InTheOffice lifetime warranty.
Keep your workspace organized with this 6-tier black mesh steel desk organizer. It features a pencil cup, two vertical slots for paper, and a small drawer for office supplies.

The BONBON 3-Tier Wire Mesh Rolling Cart is a modern, portable utility organizer designed for serving and kitchen storage. Featuring a sturdy metal frame and flexible wheels, this cart offers a total capacity of 10 shelves and weighs only 6.22 pounds for easy mobility.
This bronze 3-tier wire mesh rolling cart is designed for kitchen and utility organization. It features a metal frame with flexible wheels and a portable handle, measuring 10 x 17.5 x 25 inches.

This AIM Compatible MICR Toner Cartridge is designed for bank check and barcode printing with a 10,000-page yield. It is a replacement for HP CE390A and MicroMICR Corp MICR-THN-90A, compatible with HP LaserJet Enterprise 600 and M4555 series printers.

Get reliable check and barcode printing with this AIM compatible MICR toner cartridge, a replacement for HP CE390A / MicroMICR MICR-THN-90A that delivers up to 10,000 pages. Designed to fit HP LaserJet Enterprise 600 M601/M602/M603 series and M4555 series printers, it uses magnetic black toner built to OEM specifications.
This 9-pack of multi-colored ID badge holders features a double-sided transparent design made from PP and nylon. Each holder measures 4.4 x 2.75 inches and includes a 17.7-inch folded lanyard.

Keep your ID safe and easy to read with this Sugelary 9-pack of clear, waterproof badge holders, each with a matching colored lanyard. Made from durable PP and nylon with a double-sided transparent design, each holder fits up to two cards and helps protect them from dust, scratches, and everyday wear.

This super cute boho-style lanyard features 100% natural wood beads and a swivel snap hook closure, making it lightweight and comfortable for teachers and office workers. With a hanging length of 19.5 inches and stainless steel hardware, it securely attaches to ID badges, wallets, keys, or cardholders while offering a trendy gift option perfect for school or the workplace.

Carry ID badges, keys, and cardholders with this light-weight 19.5-inch natural wood beaded lanyard in a cute boho style. It features 4mm x 8mm wood beads, a stainless steel swivel snap hook, a safety breakaway closure, and comes in a curated gift box.

These 1.5-inch round self-adhesive address labels come in a set of 144 featuring four colorful designs. Each label can be personalized with up to three lines of text, making them ideal for envelopes or identifying personal property.

Birthday Brights Self-Adhesive Flat-Sheet Round Address Labels come in four designs and feature a 1.5-inch diameter with up to three lines of personalization for addresses or messages. This set includes 144 labels that are printed in the USA, making them perfect for adding colorful flair to your mail or organizing property like books and CDs.

Stay connected with the AT&T BL102 DECT 6.0 Cordless Phone, featuring a digital answering machine that records up to 22 minutes of messages and a smart call blocker that stops robocalls and stores up to 1,000 blacklisted numbers. The handset offers a large 2-inch screen with big text, a lighted keypad, caller ID announce, full-duplex speakerphone, and intercom for added everyday convenience.

This AT&T DECT 6.0 cordless phone features a digital answering machine with a 22-minute recording capacity and a smart call blocker to stop robocalls. The handset includes a high-contrast 2-inch screen and a lighted keypad for easy visibility.

This back-to-school banner set features a sturdy 11 x 67-inch welcome sign made of waterproof card stock, complete with warm white LED string lights and dot stickers for easy classroom decoration. The package includes 14 colorful printed cards, two white ropes, and 40 glue points to help you hang the sign horizontally or vertically on walls, doors, bulletin boards, or as photo props for memorable first-day moments.

Welcome your students back with this back-to-school banner set, featuring two hanging banners (each about 11 x 67 inches) plus warm white LED string lights and 40 glue dots for easy display. Made of sturdy, waterproof card stock, the banners work as porch signs, classroom decor, or photo backdrops for the first day of school.
This purple retractable ballpoint gel pen features a Doberman Pinscher design and purple ink. It is 5.2 inches long and crafted with a durable metallic construction and chrome accents.

Write in bold, superior-flow purple gel ink with this 5.2-inch retractable click pen featuring a "I Love My Doberman Pinscher" design, laser etched in the US. Its durable metallic body with chrome accents is perfect for school, work, or signatures.
The Killer Inked Cheetah – Sparks bottle opener features a striking cheetah design in a lightweight 3.36-ounce build that's easy to keep on hand.
The Killer Inked Cheetah - Sparks bottle opener is a compact tool weighing 3.36 ounces.
This Disney Junior Fancy Nancy Secret Diary Set comes in a pink color. The set measures 18.5 x 10 x 14 inches.
Keep your secrets safe with the Fancy Nancy Secret Diary Set from Disney Junior. This pink diary set measures 18.5 x 10 x 14 inches and is perfect for young writers who love Fancy Nancy.

This 5-pack of Cool Toner remanufactured ink cartridges replaces HP 950XL/951XL with 2 black, 1 cyan, 1 magenta, and 1 yellow cartridge, each featuring a new chip for accurate ink level display. Compatible with HP OfficeJet Pro 8100, 8600, 8610, 8620, 8630, 251dw, and 276dw printers, and backed by a 1-year warranty.

Cool Toner offers a brand-new, pre-filled replacement for the HP 950XL/951XL printer with an accurate ink level indicator and a one-year warranty. This 5-pack includes high-quality toner in black, cyan, magenta, and yellow, shipped from our West Coast warehouse to most of the Continental USA within three days.

This 60-pack of Grandstar push pin magnets comes in 7 assorted colors, with each magnet strong enough to hold up to 11 sheets of paper on fridges, whiteboards, dry erase boards, maps, lockers, and filing cabinets. Measuring 17mm high by 11mm wide, they're small enough to keep your displayed items visible while keeping notes, photos, and calendars securely in place.
This 60-pack of assorted color push pin magnets is designed for use on fridges, whiteboards, and other magnetic surfaces. Each 17 mm x 11 mm magnet can hold up to 11 pieces of paper.
This pack of four assorted Filexec Maxtallic Presentation Folders is made from durable, moisture-resistant polypropylene. Each folder features a silver swing clip that holds up to 25 pages.

Keep documents organized with these Filexec Maxtallic presentation folders, made of durable, moisture-resistant polypropylene with a silver swing clip closure that holds up to 25 pages. This pack of 4 comes in assorted colors, adding a sleek touch to reports, proposals, and school projects.
The Lang Color My World 2022 Mini Wall Calendar features 12 full-color images by Lisa Kaus on elegant linen-embossed paper. This space-efficient calendar measures 7"w x 14"h when opened.

The Lang Color My World 2022 Mini Wall Calendar features whimsical Lisa Kaus artwork on elegant linen-embossed paper, offering a space-efficient format with 12 full-color images of the year. This compact, 7-inch by 14-inch calendar is perfect for adding a touch of color and imagination to any office or home wall.

Customize and organize with this 30-piece sublimation blank set from Outus, including 15 retractable badge reels with metal clips and aluminum plates plus 15 waterproof vertical ID card holders. Ideal for personalizing badges at school or in the office.

This 30-piece set includes 15 retractable badge reels with metal clips and aluminum plates plus 15 waterproof vertical ID card holders, making it a practical choice for school or office ID display. The reels extend and retract smoothly to keep badges easy to scan or show, while the waterproof holders help protect cards from moisture.
This pocket-sized Filofax Saffiano Organizer features a fawn, leather-look cross-grain cover with a strap closure. It includes a six-ring binder and a 2022 week-to-view multilingual diary.

This Filofax Saffiano Pocket Organizer features a sophisticated cross-grain leather cover and includes a Week-to-View calendar for 2022, along with essential tools like a ruler, notepaper, and contact sheets. The compact 4-3/4" x 3-1/4" size fits easily in any desk or bag, offering ample space for daily planning tasks.
Add sparkle to your day with this hot cherry red lanyard featuring 2 rows of rhinestones and a flat sponge rubber backing. The 28-inch neck strap holds ID badges, key cards, keys, glasses, and more.

This hot cherry red bling lanyard features two rows of sparkling rhinestone crystals on a flat sponge rubber backing, measuring 28 inches to comfortably hang around your neck. It's perfect for carrying your ID badge, key card, keys, or other essentials at the office, at school, or on the go.
This 16 x 12 inch double-sided magnetic whiteboard features a foldable aluminum alloy frame and a convenient carrying handle. The set includes three dry erase markers, six magnets, and three erasers.

This 16 x 12 inch double-sided magnetic whiteboard stands on a foldable, angle-adjustable aluminum frame, letting two people write or display different content at once. The set includes 3 dry erase markers, 6 magnets, and 3 erasers, and the smooth surface wipes clean easily.

Protect letter-size documents in these Gold Seal extra heavyweight sheet protectors, made of 4 mil diamond-clear polypropylene with nonstick, non-glare pages. The 100-pack is top-loading and 3-hole punched with reinforced edges for durable everyday use.

Guard your letter-size documents with this 100-pack of 4-mil polypropylene sheet protectors, featuring diamond-clear, non-glare pages and top loading for easy insertion. The 3-hole punched margins have doubly-reinforced edges for added durability in binders.

The ESEE Model 3 fixed-blade knife features a 3 3/8-inch plain edge clip point blade in 1095 steel (57 Rc) with a desert tan finish and green canvas Micarta handles, measuring 8 3/16 inches overall and weighing just 5.2 ounces. It comes with a foliage green sheath equipped with Molle Locks and a boot clip for secure carry.
This ESEE Model 3 carving knife features a 3 3/8" plain edge 1095 steel blade and green canvas micarta handles. It includes a foliage green sheath with Molle locks and a boot clip.

The Fiskars Mess-Less Sharpener sharpens both pencils and crayons with an easy spring-action design—just squeeze, turn, and release. Shavings stay trapped inside the durable container, keeping your workspace clean, and a random color (red, blue, or pink) will be shipped.

The Mess-Less Sharpener is a durable, all-in-one tool that sharpens both pencils and crayons with an easy-to-use spring-action design. It features a built-in container to trap shavings inside, ensuring a mess-free sharpening experience for your desk.

The Nemosine Fission fountain pen features a substantially weighted navy metal body with elegant chromed trims and clip, paired with a precision stainless steel broad nib made in Germany. Each pen includes six disposable ink cartridges, a converter for bottled ink, and an instruction booklet, all inspected and packaged in the USA.

The Nemosine Fission is a precision stainless steel fountain pen featuring a substantial metal body and German-made nibs in Navy color, designed for elegant writing with a clip and trims. This specific model comes with a set of six disposable ink cartridges and includes an instruction booklet, though bottled ink is not included.

This remanufactured color ink cartridge replaces the Canon CL-241XL and delivers up to 500 pages, making it a budget-friendly option for Canon PIXMA printers including the MG2120, MG3220, MG3520, MG3620, MX472, and MX532. Each cartridge is produced from recycled empties that are disassembled, cleaned, refilled, and quality tested for reliable performance.

This is a remanufactured color ink cartridge designed to replace Canon CL-241XL models, offering a page yield of up to 500 pages for use with over 30 Canon PIXMA printers. Because the ink gauge cannot be reset on these units, holding and pressing the stop button for 10 seconds will resume printing after installation.

LUXPaper #10 Commercial Flap Business Envelopes measure 4 1/8" x 9 1/2" and come in a pack of 50 in an attractive Avocado Green shade, made from quality 70lb. text paper with a moistenable glue closure for secure mailing. These envelopes are printer compatible with commercial digital printers, off-set presses, and some home printers, making them ideal for checks, invoices, statements, and professional correspondence.

These avocado green #10 business envelopes measure 4 1/8" x 9 1/2" and feature a moistenable glue closure. This pack of 50 is made from 70lb. paper and is compatible with commercial digital and some home printers.

This 100-piece set of silver 3-in-1 pens features a 1.5mm black ink ballpoint and a capacitive rubber stylus compatible with most touch screen devices. The cap also doubles as a holder for your smartphone or tablet.

This 100-pack of silver 3-in-1 pens combines a 1.5mm black ink ballpoint, a capacitive stylus for smartphones, tablets, and other touch screens, and a cap that doubles as a phone or tablet holder to free up your hands.

This set of three soft, egg-shaped rubber grips is designed for kids to hold pencils more easily and write with greater precision using standard #2 pencils. Each grip measures 5.7 x 3.8 x 1.3 inches and weighs only 0.8 ounces.

Help little hands grip pencils with ease using these soft, egg-shaped handwriting grips developed by a therapist and handwriting expert to support more precise writing. This set of 3 rubber grips is comfortable to hold and fits #2 pencils.

Set of 2 Rustic Farmhouse Hooks in Matte Black cast iron, perfect for hanging coats and robes with a 5.5-inch span. Each hook weighs 1.08 pounds and measures 5.31 x 3.35 x 1.61 inches to fit standard bathroom hooks.
This set of two 5.5-inch cast iron wall hooks features a matte black finish for a rustic farmhouse look. They are designed for hanging coats, towels, and robes.

The Legacy Publishing Group 2016 Words to Live By wall calendar features the expressive artwork of artist Marla Rae across 12 months, opening to a spacious 13 3/8 x 24 inches. Printed in the USA in full color on linen-embossed paper, it includes a grommet-reinforced hole for tear-free hanging.

This 2016 12-month wall calendar features the expressive words of artist Marla Rae printed on high-quality linen-embossed paper. It measures 13 3/8 x 12 inches closed and includes a grommet-reinforced hole for tear-free hanging.

This is a 110-yard, 2-inch wide ProTape carton sealing tape in Tru-Clear packaging, featuring an ultra-strong bond and anti-discoloration technology that works with all hand-held dispensers. The 12-pack of rolls includes a handheld dispenser for easy use in office, warehouse, and industrial settings.

Seal shipments with confidence using ProTape's Tru-Clear heavy-duty carton sealing tape—each 2-inch, 1.9mil roll delivers 110 yards of strong, durable adhesion, and this 12-pack comes with a handheld dispenser for immediate use. Approved by UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL, the clear tape unrolls smoothly, stays fully scannable, and holds up in multiple climates.

Replace your 2000 PLUS Printer 30 style stamp with this red replacement pad, featuring a quick snap in/snap out cartridge for easy changes. Measuring 1/4" x 1-15/16", each pad delivers up to 5000 impressions.

These are red replacement pads designed for the 2000 PLUS Printer 30 style stamps, featuring a quick snap-in/snap-out cartridge design and a capacity of up to 5,000 impressions. Each pad measures 1/4" x 1-15/16" and weighs only 0.275 ounces for convenient storage.

This two-person wirebound appointment book features a one-day-per-page spread with side-by-side columns to manage schedules from January through December. It includes four future month reference blocks and covers an eight-hour workday on weekdays or six hours on Saturdays.
Manage two schedules side-by-side with this 2018 AT-A-GLANCE daily appointment book. This wirebound planner features quarter-hourly appointment times and a black simulated leather cover.

Keep your keys and ID badges close at hand with this PERU lanyard, made of high-quality polyester and measuring 23" long. The easy-separate plastic buckle lets you detach what you need quickly and conveniently.

This durable polyester lanyard strap is 23 inches long and features a separate plastic buckle for easy attachment. Perfect for organizing office supplies, holding identification badges, or keeping keys secure.

The TigTak 8-pack replacement set includes four black and four color ink cartridges designed for Brother MFC-J4320DW, MFC-J4420DW, MFC-4620DW, and MFC-J5520DW printers. Each cartridge features a smart chip that displays ink levels accurately while delivering high-quality print results with reduced clogging compared to original units.

This TigTak 8-pack of compatible replacement LC203 ink cartridges includes 2 black, 2 cyan, 2 magenta, and 2 yellow cartridges, yielding up to 500 pages per black and 450 pages per color cartridge at 5% coverage. Designed for Brother MFC-J4320DW, MFC-J4420DW, MFC-4620DW, and MFC-J5520DW printers, each cartridge features a smart chip that displays accurate ink levels.
Tackle a one-room move with the Uboxes wardrobe moving kit, which includes 10 cardboard packing boxes plus essential moving supplies in a sturdy brown cardboard design.

This Uboxes 1 Room Wardrobe Moving Kit includes ten cardboard packing boxes and essential supplies to help you safely transport your wardrobe. Each box measures 35 x 26 x 5.5 inches, making it the perfect size for moving a single large piece of furniture.

This GREENBOX Remanufactured Ink Cartridge set includes two black and one tri-color HP 61XL cartridges, designed to provide up to 650 pages of high-quality print for a wide range of HP printers including the Envy 4500 series and OfficeJet 2620.

GREENBOX remanufactured HP 61XL ink cartridge 3-pack includes 2 black and 1 tri-color cartridge, delivering up to 650 pages per black cartridge and 350 pages per color cartridge at 5% coverage. Compatible with HP Envy, DeskJet, and OfficeJet printer series, these cartridges produce clear text and vivid color graphics for everyday printing.

This National Geographic Wall Map features a traditional political design with antique coloring and includes detailed road and highway information. The map is laminated for durability, measures 23 inches by 34 inches, and comes in a protective sleeve when rolled in its cardboard tube.

Decorate your space with this National Geographic political wall map of Italy, featuring classic antique coloring, roads and highways, and a detailed 1:1,765,000 scale on a laminated 23" x 34" sheet. Made in the USA, it arrives rolled in a protective cardboard tube for easy hanging.

This lightweight, 2-lb. dry-erase calendar magnet system combines a durable board with an included Quartet marker and eraser for versatile planning on your desk or in meetings. It is designed to resist stains and ghosting while fitting easily into any workspace from personal stations to large meeting rooms.

Plan your week with the Boone Week Over Week Dry-Erase Calendar Magnet System, a lightweight board that resists stains and ghosting for lasting, clear planning space. It includes a built-in accessory tray with a Quartet marker and eraser, and moves easily from your workstation to the meeting room.

The PRT Qutie is a portable, USB-rechargeable thermal label maker that requires no ink or toner and features a 2000mAh battery capable of printing up to 980 feet on a single charge. It supports Bluetooth connectivity via the Sorticker app for iOS and Android users to customize labels with text, barcodes, and QR codes for office, kitchen, and home organization tasks.

Meet the PRT Qutie, a pocket-sized Bluetooth thermal label printer that prints crisp 203DPI labels without ink or toner using the Sorticker app on iOS and Android. Its USB-rechargeable 2000mAh battery delivers up to 980 feet of printing per charge, making it easy to organize your kitchen, office, or home with labels from 6mm to 15mm.

The JORESTECH Pneumatic Carton Box Stapler features a rugged die cast metal construction and simple one-handed operation. It requires compressed air with a minimum of 80 psi and uses Type C staples with a 1 1/4" crown and 5/8" to 3/4" legs.
